description: This file contains selectors and utility functions related to emojis in the Mattermost web application, including fetching emoji maps, recent emojis, skin tones, and reaction emojis.

methods.name: normalizeRecentEmojisData
methods.description: Normalizes recent emoji data by deduplicating entries, summing usage counts, and adjusting skin tones for system emojis.

methods.name: getUserSkinTone
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's selected emoji skin tone from preferences.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is defined (not undefined).
